note: Where a fix is made (decisions D122 and D123). On a CI of 'classes' the fix is made in EPO, by the person the check asks, and ServiceNow receives it from EPO. A Service Offering is a ServiceNow record: it comes from EPO only when the EPO integration created it, that is when its Created by is not a person's user ID ('personUserId'); then it is fixed in EPO, on its Business Service. An offering made by a person, and every other class, is fixed in ServiceNow with the request the message names. Without the Created by column, every offering counts as made by a person. The service mapped flag plays no part here: only the card EPO ≠ ServiceNow reads it. On an offering the integration created, only Owned by follows its Business Service in EPO; Managed by, Supported by and the Support group are changed in ServiceNow with the request "Add or modify a Service (CI)", action "Modify service offering" ('inServiceNow': the fields, and the checks whose finding is about one of them; decision D187).
